name: ZooTeen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Share what you know about animals and conservation with zoo guests, and help at Zoo Camp in summer.
who_can_apply: Teens from age 13 to high school seniors.
pay_detail: Unpaid. The zoo's page mentions a one-time fee that includes a uniform, but no amount is posted.
duration: Summer: one shift a week for at least 7 weeks plus one week of Zoo Camp. School year: at least 4 hours each semester plus one special event.
deadline_text: The last posted cycle opened Feb 1 and closed Mar 20. Dates for next year are not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form. Send 1 recommendation form from someone who is not a relative or family friend. Then go to a 60 minute group interview and all training sessions.
notes: The zoo's page and its info sheet differ on small things (how many recommendations, the fee). Send an email to volunteer@nashvillezoo.org before you apply. The dates on the info sheet are from the last cycle posted. They are interviews Mar 28 and 29 and Apr 11 and 12, and a summer start on May 26.
